title: Querying as Prompt: Parameter-Efficient Learning for Multimodal Language Model
caption: Figure 2. Illustration of our Querying as Prompt method in the pre-trained Language Model. The Learnable Querying Prompts, along with text embedding, are jointly input into the language model. Text information is integrated into the Querying Prompt through the frozen self-attention layer, resulting in a Text-conditioned Querying Prompt. Subsequently, the Text-conditioned Querying Prompt interacts with multimodal embeddings through the Text-conditioned Resampler module, facilitating Modality Adaptation. After obtaining text-relevant multimodal information, it undergoes Domain Adaptation by combining with text embedding through a FFN layer and an Adapter layer.
